prompt: Which jetliner first flown on June 12th, 1994 is also widely used, as of August 3, 2024, by an airline using the ICE system for entertainment on board?
answer: The jetliner is the **Boeing 777**, which first flew on **June 12, 1994**. Emirates—whose onboard entertainment system is called **ICE (Information, Communication, Entertainment)**—is one of the major airlines that widely operates Boeing 777s.
